sentences.en: Seek and you shall find, what is unsought will go undetected.
sentences.zh: 寻找就会发现，那些未被追寻的事物将不会被察觉。

sentences.en: It would be impossible to estimate how many crimes went undetected last year.
sentences.zh: 估计去年有多少犯罪行为未能被发现几乎是不可能的。

sentences.en: The security team failed to spot the intruder, leaving him undetected for hours.
sentences.zh: 安全团队未能发现入侵者，使他好几个小时都未被察觉。

senses.zh: 未被觉察的，未被发现的,未探测到的
